1. (Check the onbeforeselect event handler in the Script tab.)
2. Click the left button, right button, and menu button on the scroll bar to verify that the corresponding events occur.

Event Description

onscrollleftbtnclick - Fired when the left button of the scroll bar is clicked.
onscrollrightbtnclick - Fired when the right button of the scroll bar is clicked.
onsubmenubtnclick - Fired when the menu button of the scroll bar is clicked.
